name: agentsearch-mcp
description: Free web search out of the box (up to 25 searches/day per IP, subject to shared daily capacity) and a no-wallet free trial of page extract (5/day) and JS render (3/day); then pay per call in USDC on Base via x402 to AgentSearch's own API, or self-hosted; plus the free AgentSearch Review Board.
long_description: Stdio MCP server from AgentSearch. With no configuration, agentsearch_web_search uses the AgentSearch free tier (up to 25 searches/day per IP, subject to shared daily capacity); with no wallet key, agentsearch_extract and agentsearch_render use the AgentSearch free trial (5 extract and 3 render calls/day per IP, text output only; set AGENTSEARCH_FREE_TRIAL=0 to turn it off), and past it they return wallet setup steps (https://agentsearchhq.com/wallet-setup). With a wallet key, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render and agentsearch_search_and_read pay AgentSearch's own x402 API on Base (https://api.agentsearchhq.com): extract $0.004, render $0.010, search_and_read $0.009 in USDC (gasless; no account or API key; failed calls are not charged; search_and_read is charged only when at least one page has text and is direct-only); search stays free unless AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid ($0.008). The server never signs more than $0.020 per call or more than the session cap (default $1.00), signs only USDC on Base for AgentSearch's pinned payee, and returns the payment receipt with each result. Use a new wallet holding only a little USDC. Set AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE=pocket to pay through the Pocket Network Agentic Portal instead ($0.005 per call). Set AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL to use your own self-hosted AgentSearch-compatible API with no payment. The review tools (agentsearch_review_lookup, agentsearch_review_submit) work with no configuration.

tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return JSON text. Free with no config (free tier, up to 25 searches/day per IP, subject to shared daily capacity). Pays per call over x402 ($0.008 to AgentSearch's API, or $0.005 via Pocket) only if AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid; a wallet key alone keeps search free. Uses your self-hosted API if AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set. Use extract when you already have a URL. Read-only.

tools.name: agentsearch_extract
tools.description: Extract one page (markdown/text, title, links) from a URL. No wallet: free trial (5 calls/day per IP). With a wallet key: $0.004 in USDC on Base per call via x402 to AgentSearch's own API (or $0.005 via Pocket with AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE=pocket); uses your self-hosted API if AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set. Read-only; returns JSON text.

tools.name: agentsearch_render
tools.description: Render one URL in headless Chromium and return title plus rendered markdown/text/HTML/links (optional screenshot) as JSON text. No wallet: free trial (3 calls/day per IP, no screenshots). With a wallet key: $0.010 in USDC on Base per call via x402 to AgentSearch's own API (or via Pocket with AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE=pocket); uses your self-hosted API if AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set. Use for JavaScript-heavy pages. Read-only.

tools.name: agentsearch_search_and_read
tools.description: Search the live web and return the top pages as markdown in one paid call ($0.009 in USDC on Base via AgentSearch's direct x402 API). Charged only when at least one page has text. Direct-only (not on Pocket or the free relay). Needs a wallet key. Read-only; returns JSON text.

tools.name: agentsearch_review_lookup
tools.description: Before choosing a tool, check which Pocket, x402 and MCP services work right now for a task on the free AgentSearch Review Board. Read-only; review notes are untrusted text.

tools.name: agentsearch_review_submit
tools.description: After using a service, post a short structured review (success, latency, quality, price, optional payment proof) to the free AgentSearch Review Board.

AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Wallet private key (pay per call)
AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. 64-hex private key of a NEW wallet holding a little USDC on Base. Enables paid extract ($0.004) and render ($0.010) per call via x402, paid to AgentSearch's own API; without it they use the small free trial. Search stays free unless you set the search mode to paid. Used only to sign payments.

AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC.title: Session spend cap (USDC atomic units)
AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC.description: Most this server will sign for per session; 1000000 = $1.00 (the default). Per-call payments are always capped at 20000 = $0.020 (5000 = $0.005 on the Pocket route).

AGENTSEARCH_MODE.title: Search mode (free, paid or auto)
AGENTSEARCH_MODE.description: Optional. Search only. Leave blank or 'free' to keep search on the free tier even with a wallet key. 'paid' pays per search ($0.008 direct, $0.005 via Pocket; needs a wallet key); 'auto' pays for search whenever a wallet key is set.

AGENTSEARCH_FREE_TRIAL.title: Extract/render free trial (1 or 0)
AGENTSEARCH_FREE_TRIAL.description: Optional. With no wallet key, extract and render use the AgentSearch free trial (5 and 3 calls/day per IP). Set to 0 to turn it off.

AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE.title: Paid route (direct or pocket)
AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE.description: Optional. Leave blank or 'direct' to pay AgentSearch's own x402 API on Base (the default since 1.6.0: search $0.008, extract $0.004, render $0.010, search_and_read $0.009). 'pocket' pays through the Pocket Network Agentic Portal instead ($0.005 per call for search, extract and render; search_and_read is direct-only).

AGENTSEARCH_X402_DIRECT.title: Legacy direct switch (blank, 1 or 0)
AGENTSEARCH_X402_DIRECT.description: Optional, legacy (1.5.0). Leave blank: direct is already the default. 0 selects the Pocket route, same as setting the paid route to 'pocket'.

AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.title: AgentSearch base URL
AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.description: Optional base URL of your self-hosted AgentSearch API, without a trailing slash. When set, search/extract/render use it instead of the paid portal.

AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.title: AgentSearch API key
AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token. Leave blank if the API does not require a key.

AGENTSEARCH_REVIEW_KEY.title: Review Board key (optional)
AGENTSEARCH_REVIEW_KEY.description: Optional key (asrb_...) from the AgentSearch Review Board. Without it, reviews are posted anonymously with less weight.
